parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. Lifting the shared 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' initializer into a common package would couple production DebugPanel infrastructure to sample-app demonstration semantics. The duplication is intentional: the WallpaperSampleApp carries its own local copy of the display-link machinery so it remains self-contained and independent of the DebugPanel package.
